title: Set up the project and repository
description: Initialize the Git repository, the React front-end and the Node.js/Express back-end. Configure ESLint, Prettier, environment variables and a shared folder structure.
userStories: As a developer, I want a clean project structure so that the team can work without conflicts.
acceptanceCriteria: The front-end and back-end start with a single command.
Linting and formatting rules are shared.
A .env.example file documents all variables.

title: Design the MongoDB schemas
description: Define the Mongoose models for users, boards, columns, tasks, comments and notifications, with relations, indexes and validation rules.
userStories: As a developer, I want well-defined data models so that the API stays consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: All models include validation and timestamps.
Indexes exist on frequently queried fields.
A seed script fills the database with sample data.

title: Build the authentication API
description: Implement register, login, logout and password reset endpoints with JWT, password hashing and role-based middleware (admin, member, guest).
userStories: As a user, I want to create an account and log in securely so that my projects stay private.
acceptanceCriteria: Passwords are hashed and never returned by the API.
Protected routes reject requests without a valid token.
Roles restrict access to admin-only actions.

title: Create the authentication screens
description: Build the register, login and reset password pages in React with form validation, error messages and token storage.
userStories: As a user, I want clear login and signup forms so that I can access the application quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid fields display an error message.
A successful login redirects to the dashboard.
The pages are usable on mobile.

title: Develop the boards and columns API
description: Create REST endpoints to create, update, archive and share boards, and to manage customizable columns and card ordering.
userStories: As a team lead, I want to create boards and columns so that I can organize my team's workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: A board can be created, renamed, archived and shared.
Columns can be added, renamed and reordered.
Only board members can read or modify a board.

title: Build the Kanban board interface
description: Display boards with columns and task cards, including title, priority, due date, labels and assignees. Add task creation and edition forms.
userStories: As a user, I want to see my tasks in a board so that I can follow the progress of my project.
acceptanceCriteria: Columns and cards are displayed from API data.
A task can be created and edited from the interface.
The layout is responsive.

title: Add drag & drop with real-time updates
description: Implement card movement between columns and synchronize changes for all connected users with WebSocket (Socket.IO).
userStories: As a user, I want to drag a card to another column so that I can update its status instantly.
acceptanceCriteria: Cards can be moved between and inside columns.
Other connected users see the change without refreshing.
The order is saved after a page reload.

title: Implement assignment and comments
description: Allow assigning one or several members to a task, filtering by member, commenting on a card and viewing the activity history.
userStories: As a team member, I want to comment on a task so that I can discuss it with my colleagues.
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks can be assigned to several members.
Comments appear in chronological order.
Every modification is recorded in the activity log.

title: Create the notification system
description: Send in-app and e-mail notifications on assignment, mention and approaching deadline, with a notification center and read/unread state.
userStories: As a user, I want to be notified when a task is assigned to me so that I never miss my work.
acceptanceCriteria: Notifications are triggered by assignment, mention and deadline.
Notifications can be marked as read.
E-mails are sent through a configurable provider.

title: Build the statistics dashboard
description: Show completed, late and remaining tasks, plus workload per member, with charts and filters by period.
userStories: As a manager, I want to see statistics about my project so that I can detect delays early.
acceptanceCriteria: Charts display completed, late and remaining tasks.
Workload per member is visible.
Filters by period update the charts.

title: Write tests and API documentation
description: Add unit and integration tests for critical routes and components, and document all endpoints with Swagger.
userStories: As a developer, I want automated tests and documentation so that the project stays maintainable.
acceptanceCriteria: Critical routes are covered by tests.
Swagger lists every endpoint with examples.
All tests pass in the CI pipeline.

title: Deploy the application and prepare the demo
description: Deploy front-end and back-end online, configure environment variables and write the user guide and final presentation.
userStories: As a stakeholder, I want an online version so that I can try the application.
acceptanceCriteria: The application is accessible through a public URL.
A user guide is delivered.
A 15-minute demo scenario is prepared.

title: Set up the project and design tokens
description: Create the repository and the HTML/CSS/JS structure. Define colors, fonts, spacing and breakpoints as CSS variables.
userStories: As a visitor, I want a consistent look so that the site feels professional.
acceptanceCriteria: The folder structure is created.
Colors and fonts are defined as CSS variables.
A mobile-first base stylesheet exists.

title: Build the header, navigation and footer
description: Create a fixed navigation bar with smooth scrolling, a burger menu on mobile and a footer with social links.
userStories: As a visitor, I want a clear menu so that I can reach any section easily.
acceptanceCriteria: The navigation stays visible while scrolling.
The burger menu works on mobile.
Footer links point to GitHub and LinkedIn.

title: Create the home page
description: Build the hero section with photo, professional title, short introduction and a call-to-action button to the projects section.
userStories: As a recruiter, I want a strong first impression so that I want to learn more.
acceptanceCriteria: The hero section is displayed above the fold.
The call-to-action scrolls to the projects.
Images are optimized.

title: Create the About section
description: Write and display the career path, education, interests and key skills with icons or progress bars.
userStories: As a recruiter, I want to read about the candidate's skills so that I can evaluate the profile.
acceptanceCriteria: Education and career are listed clearly.
Skills are displayed visually.
The section is readable on all screens.

title: Build the projects gallery
description: Render project cards generated from a JavaScript array with image, title, description, technologies and links to source and demo.
userStories: As a recruiter, I want to browse the projects so that I can see real work.
acceptanceCriteria: Cards are generated from data with JavaScript.
Each card has links to code and demo.
The grid adapts to the screen size.

title: Create the contact form with validation
description: Build a form (name, email, message) with client-side validation using regular expressions and a confirmation message.
userStories: As a visitor, I want to send a message so that I can contact the developer.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid fields show an error under the input.
The submit button is disabled while the form is invalid.
A confirmation is shown after submission.

title: Add dark mode
description: Implement a light/dark theme toggle based on CSS variables, saved in localStorage and detecting system preference by default.
userStories: As a visitor, I want a dark mode so that I can read comfortably at night.
acceptanceCriteria: The toggle switches the theme instantly.
The choice is kept after reload.
Contrast stays accessible in both themes.

title: Run the responsive and accessibility audit
description: Test all breakpoints, check semantic HTML, alt attributes and contrasts, and reach a Lighthouse score above 90.
userStories: As a visitor with a disability, I want an accessible site so that I can use it without barriers.
acceptanceCriteria: Lighthouse performance and accessibility are above 90.
All images have alt text.
Keyboard navigation works everywhere.

title: Deploy and write the README
description: Publish the site on GitHub Pages or Netlify and write a README with screenshots and setup instructions.
userStories: As a recruiter, I want a public link so that I can open the portfolio.
acceptanceCriteria: The site is online.
The README explains how to run the project.
The link is added to the GitHub profile.

title: Define the architecture and set up the monorepo
description: Document the target architecture, set up the monorepo (Next.js, NestJS), Docker Compose for local services and coding conventions.
userStories: As a developer, I want a clear architecture so that five people can work in parallel.
acceptanceCriteria: An architecture diagram is committed.
The whole stack starts with docker compose up.
Conventions and branching strategy are documented.

title: Design the PostgreSQL schema and migrations
description: Model products, variants, categories, users, orders, payments and stock movements. Write migrations, indexes and seed data.
userStories: As a developer, I want a reliable data model so that orders and stock stay consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: All tables are created by migrations.
Foreign keys and indexes are defined.
Seed data generates a realistic catalog.

title: Implement authentication and roles
description: Build signup, login (email and social), JWT refresh, password reset and role-based guards for admin, stock manager and support.
userStories: As a customer, I want to log in securely so that I can see my orders.
acceptanceCriteria: Social and email login work.
Guards block unauthorized roles.
Tokens are refreshed securely.

title: Build the catalog API
description: Create endpoints for products, categories and variants with search, filters, sorting and pagination, plus CSV import for admins.
userStories: As a customer, I want to filter products so that I can find what I need quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Filters by category, price, brand and availability work.
Pagination and sorting are supported.
CSV import reports invalid rows.

title: Create the catalog pages
description: Build the product listing page with server-side rendering, search bar, filters, sorting and pagination for SEO and performance.
userStories: As a customer, I want a fast catalog so that I can browse many products easily.
acceptanceCriteria: The listing is server-side rendered.
Filters update the URL and results.
The page is responsive.

title: Create the product page with variants and reviews
description: Display image gallery, size/color variants, real-time stock and customer reviews with ratings.
userStories: As a customer, I want to choose a size and color so that I get the right product.
acceptanceCriteria: Variants update price and stock.
Out-of-stock variants cannot be added to the cart.
Customers can post a review after purchase.

title: Implement the shopping cart
description: Add, remove and update quantities, apply promotion codes, compute taxes and shipping, and persist the cart across sessions.
userStories: As a customer, I want my cart saved so that I can come back later.
acceptanceCriteria: Quantities and totals update instantly.
Promotion codes are validated by the server.
The cart persists after logout and login.

title: Integrate Stripe payments
description: Implement checkout with Stripe, webhooks for payment status, order confirmation emails and refund handling.
userStories: As a customer, I want to pay securely online so that I can complete my purchase.
acceptanceCriteria: Payments are processed through Stripe.
Webhooks update the order status.
A confirmation email is sent.

title: Build order management and PDF invoices
description: Create order statuses (paid, shipped, delivered, refunded), tracking numbers and automatic PDF invoice generation.
userStories: As an administrator, I want to manage order statuses so that customers are informed.
acceptanceCriteria: Statuses can be updated by authorized roles.
Invoices are generated in PDF.
Customers see their order history.

title: Develop the admin dashboard
description: Build the back-office for products, stock alerts, customers, roles and sales statistics (revenue, best sellers, conversion, abandoned carts).
userStories: As a manager, I want sales statistics so that I can make business decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Stock alerts appear on low inventory.
Charts show revenue and best sellers.
Access depends on the user role.

title: Add Redis caching and performance optimization
description: Cache catalog queries and sessions with Redis, optimize images and SQL queries, and run load tests.
userStories: As a customer, I want pages to load quickly so that I do not leave the site.
acceptanceCriteria: Main pages load in under 2 seconds.
Cache invalidation works on product updates.
The platform supports 1,000 concurrent users in load tests.

title: Harden security and GDPR compliance
description: Protect against XSS, CSRF and SQL injection, add rate limiting, cookie consent, data export and account deletion.
userStories: As a customer, I want my personal data protected so that I can trust the shop.
acceptanceCriteria: Security scans show no critical issue.
Users can export and delete their data.
Cookie consent is implemented.

title: Set up automated tests and the CI/CD pipeline
description: Write unit, integration and end-to-end tests (70% coverage on business logic) and automate build, test and deployment.
userStories: As a developer, I want automated checks so that regressions are caught before release.
acceptanceCriteria: Coverage reaches 70% on business logic.
Every pull request runs the test suite.
Merging to main deploys to staging.

title: Deploy to production and deliver documentation
description: Deploy staging and production, configure monitoring, deliver API docs, database schema, admin guide and train the client team.
userStories: As a client, I want a documented production system so that my team can operate it.
acceptanceCriteria: Production meets the 99.5% availability target.
Documentation is complete.
The client team is trained.

title: Set up React Native and Firebase
description: Initialize the React Native (TypeScript) project, configure Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Cloud Messaging) and the navigation structure.
userStories: As a developer, I want a working base project so that the team can build features on it.
acceptanceCriteria: The app runs on iOS and Android emulators.
Firebase is connected.
Tab navigation is in place.

title: Build authentication and user profile
description: Implement signup, login and profile screens (age, weight, height, level, goals) with form validation.
userStories: As a user, I want to set my goals so that the app adapts to me.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can sign up and log in.
Profile data is saved in Firestore.
Invalid fields show clear errors.

title: Create the exercise library
description: Add 100+ exercises with description, target muscles and illustrations, with search and filters by muscle group.
userStories: As a user, I want to browse exercises so that I know how to perform them.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 100 exercises are available.
Search and muscle filters work.
Each exercise has an illustration.

title: Build the workout builder and session logging
description: Let users create custom workouts and log sets, reps, weights and rest times in under 30 seconds.
userStories: As a user, I want to log a set quickly so that I can stay focused on training.
acceptanceCriteria: A workout can be created from the library.
Logging a set takes at most a few taps.
Sessions are saved to history.

title: Add the rest timer and HIIT mode
description: Implement an integrated rest timer, interval training mode and sound/vibration alerts, also working in the background.
userStories: As a user, I want an automatic rest timer so that I do not need another app.
acceptanceCriteria: The timer starts after each set.
HIIT intervals are configurable.
Alerts work with the screen locked.

title: Implement GPS tracking
description: Record runs and bike rides with distance, speed and elevation, and display the route on a map.
userStories: As a runner, I want to track my route so that I can measure my progress.
acceptanceCriteria: The route is drawn on a map.
Distance, pace and elevation are computed.
Tracking continues in the background.

title: Create statistics and progress charts
description: Display weight evolution, training volume and personal records with weekly and monthly charts.
userStories: As a user, I want to see my progress so that I stay motivated.
acceptanceCriteria: Charts show weight and volume over time.
Personal records are highlighted.
Period filters work.

title: Add goals and achievement badges
description: Allow weekly goals and automatically award badges for streaks, records and milestones.
userStories: As a user, I want rewards for my efforts so that I keep training regularly.
acceptanceCriteria: Weekly goals can be defined.
Badges are awarded automatically.
Progress toward each goal is displayed.

title: Develop the social features
description: Add friends, leaderboards and group challenges with push notifications.
userStories: As a user, I want to challenge my friends so that training becomes more fun.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can add and remove friends.
Challenges have a leaderboard.
Push notifications announce invitations.

title: Implement offline mode and synchronization
description: Store data locally, queue changes while offline and synchronize with Firestore when the connection returns, with conflict handling.
userStories: As a user, I want to log workouts without internet so that I can train anywhere.
acceptanceCriteria: Workouts can be logged offline.
Data syncs automatically when online.
No data is lost or duplicated.

title: Test on devices and publish the beta
description: Test on at least 5 devices, fix bugs, ensure GDPR account deletion, and publish the beta on TestFlight and Google Play.
userStories: As a tester, I want a stable beta so that I can give useful feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: A test report covers 5 different devices.
Account deletion removes user data.
The beta is installable on both stores.

title: Define the architecture and provision infrastructure
description: Design the data platform architecture, set up the repository, CI, Kubernetes cluster, object storage and PostgreSQL environments.
userStories: As a data engineer, I want a solid infrastructure so that pipelines run reliably.
acceptanceCriteria: An architecture diagram is validated.
Dev and staging environments are provisioned.
Infrastructure is described as code.

title: Build the data ingestion connectors
description: Develop importers for CSV/Excel files, SQL databases and external APIs, with scheduled synchronizations in Airflow.
userStories: As an analyst, I want to connect my data sources so that everything is centralized.
acceptanceCriteria: CSV, Excel, SQL and API sources are supported.
Syncs run on a schedule.
Failures raise alerts and can be retried.

title: Create the cleaning and transformation pipeline
description: Detect missing values, normalize formats, remove duplicates and log each transformation step.
userStories: As an analyst, I want clean data so that my indicators are trustworthy.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing values and duplicates are handled by rules.
Every transformation is logged.
Data quality reports are generated.

title: Model the data warehouse
description: Design the star schema with fact and dimension tables and implement incremental refresh.
userStories: As an analyst, I want a structured warehouse so that queries are fast and consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: Fact and dimension tables are created.
Incremental refresh works.
A data dictionary is documented.

title: Develop the indicators API with FastAPI
description: Expose KPIs, filters and aggregations through documented, authenticated REST endpoints.
userStories: As a front-end developer, I want a clean API so that I can build dashboards easily.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoints return KPIs with filters.
OpenAPI documentation is generated.
Responses are cached for heavy queries.

title: Build the interactive dashboards
description: Create the React dashboards with interactive charts, dynamic filters, period comparison, PDF export and secure share links.
userStories: As a decision maker, I want interactive dashboards so that I can explore the data myself.
acceptanceCriteria: Charts update with filters.
Dashboards load in under 3 seconds.
A dashboard can be exported to PDF and shared by link.

title: Train the forecasting models
description: Build time-series models to forecast sales and stock needs, evaluate them and expose predictions with confidence intervals.
userStories: As a planner, I want sales forecasts so that I can anticipate stock needs.
acceptanceCriteria: Mean error is below 10% on the last three months.
Forecasts include confidence intervals.
Evaluation is documented in notebooks.

title: Implement anomaly detection and alerts
description: Detect unusual variations of key indicators and send automatic alerts to the concerned users.
userStories: As a manager, I want alerts on abnormal values so that I can react quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Anomalies are flagged automatically.
Alerts are sent by email and in the app.
Thresholds are configurable.

title: Build the AI assistant for natural-language queries
description: Translate questions into safe, read-only queries, return the result with a chart and explain the answer.
userStories: As a manager, I want to ask questions in plain language so that I do not need to know SQL.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 80% of the test questions are answered correctly.
Only read-only queries are executed.
Each answer includes a chart when relevant.

title: Implement access control and audit log
description: Add roles, dataset-level permissions and a complete audit journal of user actions.
userStories: As an administrator, I want to control who sees which data so that sensitive information is protected.
acceptanceCriteria: Permissions apply per dataset.
All sensitive actions are logged.
Unauthorized access is denied and recorded.

title: Set up MLflow versioning and automatic retraining
description: Track experiments, version models and schedule monthly retraining with validation before promotion.
userStories: As a data scientist, I want versioned models so that I can reproduce and roll back results.
acceptanceCriteria: Models are tracked and versioned in MLflow.
Retraining runs monthly.
A model is promoted only if it passes validation.

title: Secure data and anonymize personal information
description: Encrypt data at rest and in transit and anonymize personal data in analytical datasets.
userStories: As a data protection officer, I want personal data anonymized so that the platform is compliant.
acceptanceCriteria: Data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
Personal fields are anonymized in the warehouse.
A compliance checklist is completed.

title: Deploy on Kubernetes and configure monitoring
description: Deploy all services to preproduction, configure Prometheus and Grafana monitoring, and run load and performance tests.
userStories: As an operator, I want monitoring so that I can detect issues before users do.
acceptanceCriteria: All services run on Kubernetes.
Dashboards monitor health and performance.
Load tests meet the performance targets.

title: Write documentation and transfer knowledge
description: Deliver architecture docs, data dictionary, user guide, model performance report and train the client's data team.
userStories: As a client, I want complete documentation so that my team can run the platform alone.
acceptanceCriteria: All documents are delivered.
A model performance report is included.
A training session is completed.
